original.indicated: relink re-points the base and writes a relink entry with no tree; the lock gate and drift compare the last freeze's and the lock's files

issue.why_categorical: relink changes a file the freeze and lock recorded, and ends a strap lock
issue.why_free_form: relink rewrites the plan JSON (base_commit) and SkillSpec.json (base): check then reports drift on a relinked Locked subject and plan.py lock refuses a relinked Frozen plan until a refreeze. strap_lock.is_locked read 'top entry is a lock', so a relink silently unlocked a spec, and freeze_ledger.locked_files kept a lock after reopen, so the guard denied a reopened spec's files

new_outcome.indicated: the relink entry carries the held files (lock when Locked, else last freeze) with the subject file's new blob; freeze_ledger.held picks the newest such entry; the plan lock gate, lock (tree rebuilt from them) and both drift checks read it; relink saves before it writes its entry; is_locked reads state() over the current round; locked_files binds a lock to its own round

why_new_outcome.free_form: the developer chose this (relink entry carries files): relink after a rebase needs no unlock/refreeze cycle, and reopen stays the way into a Locked spec
